title: Anker's Black Friday Steals: The Lowest Prices Yet on MagSafe Favorites
content:
Anker's big Black Friday sale has officially kicked off this week, with many discounts being matched (or beaten) at Amazon. Anker's SOLIX brand also has major savings on portable power stations, with up to 54 percent off select accessories.

Note: MacRumors is an affiliate partner with Anker. When you click a link and make a purchase, we may receive a small payment, which helps us keep the site running.

Amazon has one of the highlights of this event, with the new Anker Prime 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station on sale for $128.24, down from $229.99. There's also the Anker Prime 3-in-1 Foldable Wireless Charger for $94.74, down from $149.99. Both of these are MagSafe-compatible chargers, and these prices are matching the previous Amazon all-time lows.

$101 OFF
Anker Prime 3-in-1 Charging Stand for $128.24

$55 OFF
Anker Prime 3-in-1 Foldable Charger for $94.74


Amazon also has the new MagGo 2 Magnetic Power Banks on sale for $85.99, down from $109.99. These are color matched to go with the new iPhone 18 Pro models, and feature a 10,000 mAh battery.

$24 OFF
Anker MagGo 2 Magnetic Power Bank for $85.99


On Anker's website, you can get up to 49% off Anker's best wall chargers, power banks, MagSafe-compatible accessories, cables, power strips, docks, and more. There's also Anker's popular blind boxes, which contain contain surprise accessories at a discount.

There are four blind boxes available, starting at $39.99 for the Silver Blind Box, which contains one of four randomly selected accessories that have potential value of up to $129.99. For every blind box, you are guaranteed to at least save some money, as each box is priced below the cheapest accessory that you could receive.
